summary: Pure DRY refactor matches the saved plan exactly. The shared helper create_workspace_row_checked was added to src/awf/service/workspaces_create.py with the planned signature (session, repo, payload, *, idempotency_key, settings, disk_check, node_id, excluding_workspace_id) -> Workspace; it resolves the profile snapshot once via workspace_create_profile_snapshots, lazily imports check_host_port_conflicts (# noqa: E402) to avoid the load-time cycle, guards host-port conflicts, and forwards requested_profile/resolved_profile to create_workspace_row so the snapshot is not recomputed. Both entry points were rewired to call it: WorkspaceService.create() keeps its idempotency-key lock/payload-match, disk check, and s.commit(); the REST route keeps its rate-limit/durable-replay/disk-admission and the unchanged try/except HTTP mapping, passing excluding_workspace_id=None. Route imports were cleaned (dropped check_host_port_conflicts/create_workspace_row/workspace_create_profile_snapshots, added create_workspace_row_checked), and the helper is re-exported through awf.service.workspaces and __all__. Non-goals respected: api/schemas.py, openapi.json, and the MCP layer are untouched (OpenAPI drift gate unaffected) and check_host_port_conflicts was not moved. Tests match the plan: new tests/unit/service/test_workspace_create_helper.py adds the snapshot-once-and-forward, parametrized host-port-conflict propagation, and disk_check/settings/idempotency_key pass-through cases, and the route part_002 tests were retargeted to monkeypatch create_workspace_row_checked. Validation evidence: the pytest cache shows the last run collected exactly the plan's focused create-path suites (test_workspaces_direct, test_workspaces_parts/*, test_host_port_conflict_helper, test_workspace_create_helper incl. all 4 new tests, test_workspace_idempotency, test_workspaces) across 275 nodeids with lastfailed empty (all passing). Broad ruff/format/mypy/coverage/OpenAPI-drift gates remain AWF/CI-owned and will run in the validation phase; the scoped diff and untouched contract make those gates unaffected by inspection.
